Get the stylish design, energy efficiency and home warranty of a new home with the quick move-in timeline and turnkey experience you thought you’d only find with used homes.

Here, energy efficiency isn’t just a feature, it’s a philosophy woven into every detail. From insulation to appliances, our homes are designed to help you lower costs and enjoy a more comfortable way of living.
We’ve been pushing ourselves to higher standards for 40+ years. We don’t do it for the glory, though. We raise the bar on homebuilding because your home deserves the best.
Having real estate agent representation offers major advantages when buying your dream home. Let their expertise work for you.

It’s simple. The experience in buying anything, especially a home, comes down to customer service. The Meritage people were beyond reproach. Their pleasantries, intellect, and work ethic were beyond reproach. An absolute pleasure! I won’t hesitate to buy a Meritage home if I get the chance again.

Growing up in a small town, I always dreamt of owning my own home. After years of hard work and saving, I finally achieved that dream with the help of Meritage Homes. From the moment I walked into their sales office, I knew I was in good hands. The process was smooth, and their team guided me every step of the way. Now, as I sit in the comfort of my new home, I'm filled with gratitude for this milestone in my life. Thank you, Meritage Homes, for making my dream a reality.

I bought my house over the internet looking at the video and to be honest I was not 100% sure about all the things but to my surprise, the house was exactly the way it was explained it to me. [The Meritage team] was extremely helpful with explaining all the do’s and don’ts for the house. [They] also helped to take care of some minor stuff swiftly. Always kept good communication and are always keeping tabs of the jobs that were scheduled to be done.

As an agent, I'm always looking for builders who truly prioritize value, transparency, and thoughtful design—and Meritage Homes checks every box. From their energy-efficient features and included solar to their 'Everything's Included' approach, Meritage takes guesswork (and hidden costs!) out of [the] new-build process. Their homes are not only beautifully designed but also incredibly functional for modern families. [I] love referring clients to Meritage because [I] know they're in good hands. [This is a] builder that delivers quality, integrity, [and an] effortless buying experience every step [of the] way.

raw_blocks: We value our real estate agent partners. So we treat you like rock stars.

Since launching Agents Rock in 2015, Meritage Homes has been strengthening its commitment to real estate agents. Now, we’re turning it up a notch with even more tools, rewards, and client advantages designed to help you grow your business.
Your Key to Efficiency: Agents Rock Rewards Portal
We've invested in technology to make your job easier. The Agent Portal is your central hub for everything Meritage:
Access our entire inventory with enhanced search filters only found in the portal.
Manage your clients and more – all in one place.
Streamline your workflow and find dream homes faster with our user-friendly platform, a testament to our ongoing commitment over the past 10 years.

As we celebrate 10 years of partnership, we're excited to showcase a robust rewards program designed to make growing your business easier. With exciting new benefits, opportunities to grow your business and more – all inspired by real feedback from agent partners, this is something you don’t want to miss. Sign up now to earn valuable rewards and unlock exclusive benefits as you grow with us.
Rewards you can actually use.
Some rewards programs give you a free pastry. Agents Rock Rewards gives you access to exclusive resources, practical tools, and support to grow your business. Ready for the real deal?
Give Your Clients the Best of Both Worlds

Give your clients the stylish design, energy efficiency and home warranty of a new home with the quick-closing timeline and turnkey experience they thought they’d only find with used homes. When your clients buy with Meritage, they’ll open the door to a home that’s ready to start living.
How to position Meritage energy efficiency in a simple, buyer-friendly way.
With our Closing-Ready Guarantee, your client's new home is ready to close in 60 days or less.
Our homes are Move-In Ready so your clients can go from house to home on Day 1 with:
A full suite of new Whirlpool® appliances: Refrigerator, range, microwave, dishwasher, and washer/dryer.

At close of escrow for the sale of the home, Meritage Homes will pay a real estate commission solely in accordance with, and subject to, the terms and conditions of a fully executed Broker Registration and Commission Addendum that accompanies the applicable Purchase Agreement. As a condition to the payment of any commission, the real estate agent must provide a completed and fully executed Broker Registration and Commission Addendum (in the form provided with the Purchase Agreement) within 24 hours after the buyer executes the applicable contract for the home.

Any real estate agent representing the buyer in a transaction for the purchase of a Meritage home represents only the prospective buyer as a “Buyer Broker.” The agent does not represent, act on behalf of, or owe fiduciary duties to Meritage Homes Corporation or any of its affiliated entities.
Real estate agent must hold an active real estate license in the state where the home is located.

If Addendum is executed in connection with a contract for the sale of a home, the real estate agent shall be solely responsible for obtaining a signed release from the broker previously identified on the Broker Registration and Commission form as a condition precedent to changing the broker of record. Absent such release, Meritage Homes will not recognize any party other than the broker named in such form as sole to the original broker identified in section 5.

Buyer's realtor, agent and/or broker is/are solely responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable National Association of Realtor guidelines, regulations, and ethical standards. The Agents Rock Rewards program and any benefits are subject to any applicable laws and governmental restrictions. Agents Rock Rewards Program is void in states where prohibited by law. Meritage Homes reserves the right to terminate or amend this program at any time, in part if such changes affect rewards payable under this program without prior notice or obligation; even if it affects points that conditions of participation, participation qualification criteria or benefits earned. Meritage Homes further reserves the right, in its sole discretion to revoke a participant's membership or status in Agents Rock Rewards Program at any time without prior notice or obligation. Eligibility to hold open houses and/or to represent Meritage Homes listings is subject to the sole and absolute discretion of Meritage Homes.

All agents are eligible to participate in Meritage’s Agents Rock Rewards Program in any state in which an agent is licensed or otherwise authorized to serve as a residential home broker. Closings required for promotion to Platinum and Diamond Tiers include closings for any homes. Meritage closings are automatically counted for the promotion to Platinum and Diamond Tiers. Closings that are not Meritage homes will count toward promotion to Platinum and Diamond Tiers upon documentation provided by agent to Meritage. In addition, Agents Rock Rewards members may inquire with Meritage regarding promotion to higher tiers on a trial basis.

Meritage Homes retains all rights, title, and interest in and to its marketing materials, including photographs, renderings, floorplans, videos, virtual tours, and other promotional content. Participation in the Agents Rock Rewards Program, listing of Meritage homes, or receipt of any program benefits does not grant any license or authorization to use, reproduce, distribute, or republish such materials for the resale, lease, or other marketing of a home after its sale by Meritage Homes. Any such use requires the prior written consent of Meritage Homes, which may be withheld in its sole discretion.
©2026 Meritage Homes Corporation. All rights reserved.
